questions.prompt: The input is an account code 0042. What should control its spoken form?
questions.explanation: Identifiers and quantities need different reading policies. Preserve the intended information.

questions.prompt: A name is pronounced incorrectly. What is a useful controlled test?
options: Compare its phoneme sequence with the intended pronunciation
questions.explanation: Inspecting phonemes can localize a pronunciation issue before changing the acoustic model.

questions.prompt: After adding a pronunciation override, what should you check?
options: The target word in context and unaffected regression examples
questions.explanation: An override can behave differently in context or affect other inputs. Listen to both target and regression cases.
